correction: PR #265 believed a logged completion failure was enough. Reality: a ResolvePaths or MarkDone error left the Done step saying 'Your user account is ready to use'. Completion now carries Err and ShowWarning, and DoneState shows the warning and an error-log entry. The 'starts again at your next login' text shows only when no marker exists after the failure (DoneAt is false); a partial failure that left a marker shows 'Setup finished with errors'.
